title: Quasimorphisms and Pseudo-Anosov flows
summary: We describe two connections between the theory of quasimorphisms and pseudo-Anosov flows without perfect fits on closed hyperbolic 3-manifolds. First we show that for every such flow $X$, there are quasimorphisms whose coarse restriction to each flowline of $\tilde{X}$ (the lifted flow in the universal cover) are uniform quasi-isometries to $\mathbb{R}$ -- such quasimorphisms are said to be *adapted* to $X$; and that the space of quasimorphisms $Q_X$ adapted to $X$ is an open convex cone in the space of all quasimorphisms on $π_1(M)$.
